# HerbChina Extracts — llms.txt

HerbChina Extracts (https://herbchina-extracts.vercel.app/) is a botanical and
mushroom extract supplier based in Xi'an, China, founded in 2019. We serve
overseas B2B buyers (supplement, food, and nutraceutical brands) with bulk
botanical extracts, mushroom extracts, and related ingredients. We are a
trading company working with vetted partner producers; quotations are
prepared against buyer specifications with COA/TDS documentation arranged
per batch. Product images on this site are illustrative diagrams, not
photographs of our facilities or inventory.

## Product pages

402 bulk ingredient pages, one per product, each with a specification table
(appearance, marker compounds, analytical methods), applications, related
products, and product-specific FAQs with FAQPage structured data. Full list:
https://herbchina-extracts.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

Popular categories: adaptogens (ashwagandha, rhodiola, ginseng), mushroom
extracts (reishi, lion's mane, cordyceps), antioxidants (green tea EGCG,
grape seed, pine bark), and functional powders (creatine monohydrate,
magnesium glycinate, NMN).
